_basis: AGENTS.md, Redundancy: every energy and life-support function (power, O2, water, CO2 removal, thermal, food, sanitation) keeps N+1 or a source of a diverse technology. AQS-PLAN-011 sections 5.2 and 5.5. The source lists are the reference plant's; the owner confirms them (AQS-PLAN-011 section 14).
rule: a function needs at least 2 source units after the site's scaling actions; a unit's internal parallel trains count when the unit states them

power_storage.basis: AQS-ELEC-007; Q-009 pumped hydro as the second storage

thermal_storage.basis: AQS-HEAT-STUDY-002 (A and B heat batteries per ladder level)

heat_rejection.basis: AQS-HEAT-STUDY-002 section 10.8 (dry cooler); geothermal loop as the ground path

oxygen.basis: AQS-PAR-005 (oxygen from water electrolysis; air separation as the second source)

co2_removal.basis: driver HAB.life-support-train.HABITATION.cdra_half_cycle_min (ISS CO2 removal basis); plant uptake in the grow bed

food.basis: grow bed; food buffer store (D-DOCK owner ruling 2026-10-19)

sanitation.basis: A-M-118: black digest and compost toilets, each path sized for 100 %
